newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock funds post outflows -- Trim Tabs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock funds post outflows -- Trim Tabs.

text.p: Cash flows into U.S. mutual funds, including stock funds, took a sharp U-turn for the three days ended Thursday, with investors pulling cash out, according to a California fund tracker.
Mutual Funds Trim Tabs said its survey found that for the period ended Oct 10, U.S. equity funds recorded outflows of $300 million versus inflows of $1.4 billion for the two-day period ended Oct 7.
International stock funds recorded outflows of $1 billion versus inflows of $900 million.
Bond funds had outflows of $1.3 billion versus a flat level for the previous two-day period.
Within stock funds, aggressive growth funds had outflows of $740 million versus inflows of $200 million, while growth and income funds had inflows of $700 million versus inflows of $500 million.
Trim Tabs said the three-day period appears to be an abberation. It said that based on data for the month to date, U.S. stock funds should still wind up with inflows of about $12 billion.
